site.name: Suicide Basin (Mendenhall Glacier)
site.notes: Ice-dammed basin with near-annual outbursts — best site for supervised labels.

title: Three-indicator GLOF change observatory
assessment_explanation: Inspect lake area, annual glacier movement and dated surface change together. Each indicator has separate dates and evidence limits.
confidence_kind: qualitative evidence grade; not a calibrated event probability

lake.interpretation: Mapped area only. Missing water under snow/ice and ambiguous shorelines remain unresolved; changes are review candidates.
lake.confidence_basis: Heuristic water-map evidence grade only: median optical-reference IoU 0.0 across 2 checks with at least100 annotated water pixels. Automatic references and date mismatch remain uncertain. This does not grade breach forecasting.
lake.confidence_kind: Heuristic water-map grade from automatic optical references; not event probability.

movement.interpretation: Annual movement of the mapped glacier candidate within the downloaded AOI, not a short-term surge forecast.
movement.baseline_rule: Median of glacier-mask annual medians through 2022; at least three years; ratio withheld when baseline <=5m/yr.
movement.caveat: Outline may predate observations. AOI clips the glacier. Per-pixel velocity uncertainty is not fully propagated; confidence is a heuristic evidence grade.
movement.quality_note: Count is annual image-pair support; v_error is integer-quantized m/year, so zero is not exact zero uncertainty. These diagnostics are not a confidence interval on the mask median.

elevation.interpretation: Partial surface-volume change over a historical glacier outline on common valid terrain, not total glacier volume or lake water volume.
elevation.reason: No matched high-resolution repeat DEMs with a usable glacier outline for this site.

glacier_candidate.geometry_role: latest available outline per GLIMS glacier ID; not a validated feeding-glacier delineation

glacier_attribution: Spatial candidate selection prefers a named glacier >=1km² within 2km, then a substantial nearby outline, then nearest within 5km. Hydrological linkage is unverified. Statistics use only downloaded grid intersections.

sources.detail: Real NISAR pair with concept IDs; separate GPU 1 radiometric regression. No NISAR water/hazard accuracy claimed.
NISAR is joint NASA–ISRO. No ISRO S-band observations are silently substituted by ESA Sentinel-1.
52 real same-orbit epochs, 2022-01-02 to 2024-12-17. Model trained on hand-labelled C-band GRD: RTC radiometric/domain transfer is evaluated separately.
Cloud/snow-masked spectral references, fixed independently of SAR. Date gaps and automatic label uncertainty are reported.
Real 30 m DSM, resampled onto 20 m processing grid. Local relief is a HAND proxy, not hydrologically derived HAND.
Measured annual velocity and available 1985–2022 median. Velocity is not a glacier thinning measurement.

sources.product: Repeat terrain and partial glacier surface change

sources.provider: Joint NASA–ISRO mission / NASA ASF access

records.selection_rule: latest available okay glacial boundary per glacier ID, source year >=1980; reconstructed older outlines retained only in raw source
records.citation: GLIMS Glacier Database, Version 1; GLIMS/NSIDC. Per-feature submitter, analysis ID, source date and analyst affiliation retained.
records.limitation: Latest source date varies by glacier and may be historical. IDs can represent different delineations; union masks avoid double-counting overlapping outlines. No automatic feeding-glacier identity is certified.

source_raster.note: existing bounded crop; source URL retained

records.limitation: Aggregated historical context only; includes dates after 2023 and must not be used as pre-event prediction truth or current lake level.

records.limitation: Annual image-pair support and velocity error do not quantify breach probability. vx/vy are source-grid components; geographic vector interpretation requires the product projection. v_error is integer-quantized; valid zero is not proof of exactly zero uncertainty.
